_comment: Tier-2 for febio::linear_elasticity#1. A deck with <Mesh> followed directly by <Boundary> is rejected with 'tag "bc" (line N) : invalid value for attribute "node_set"' — NOT with a missing-domain error. The fixture pins both halves: the quoted message, and the absence of the words MeshDomains / SolidDomain / MeshDomain anywhere in the output, which is what makes the diagnosis misleading. The positive control — the same deck with only the one wrong thing put right — is what makes the observed message attributable to the trigger rather than to anything else in the deck. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF). MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 leaves <MeshDomains> in place in the "wrong" slot. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectation 'meshdomains_missing=reproduced' is no longer printed and the forbidden token 'not_reproduced' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/Schreibtisch/open-fem-agent/.venv/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness).
